name: Meryl
review:
We loved staying here! Right on the beach. My kids loved exploring low tide. Nice array of chairs and umbrellas for shade. Nice bakery - Scratch - pretty close. Very communicative hosts. Want to come back for sure.
Hope he changes the dining room chairs at some point - a little low and uncomfortable. We loved all the outdoor seating though.

name: Kim
review:
Dmitry's place was lovely! It was super comfortable and fully stocked! You felt like you were actually at your home beach house instead of a rental.
I have stayed at many Air B & B's and have never seen one so well stocked. You didn't want for anything.
I would absolutely stay there again...but longer next time!

name: David
review:
It was really great being able to stay directly on the beach. We loved the view from the master bedroom and the games that were available at the house. Dmitry and team were always fast to respond and were very communicative.
Unfortunately we did have two things that we wish were corrected. The toilet clogged on the first night and their team wasn’t able to come fix it until after our stay had ended. They are also building a large house right next door so the noise during the weekdays was unfortunate when you want to relax by the beach.

name: Brenda
review:
We had a great girls' weekend at Dimitri's beach house! It's a cute, cozy place right on the beach and was exactly what we were looking for.
We hosted a book club gathering during our stay, and the house was the perfect spot to spend time with friends while enjoying the beautiful beach views. We loved taking walks along the beach, and one of us even enjoyed taking a kayak out on the Sound. We also gathered around the fire pit one evening and watched a beautiful full moon.
Dmitry was easy to communicate with and very accommodating whenever we needed assistance. We really appreciated his responsiveness and help throughout  our stay.
Overall, this was a fun, relaxing getaway in a wonderful location. We made some great memories and would happily stay here again.

name: Alex
review: We stayed for a weekend at the house, the location was incredible, right on the water. Description and photos matched the property which is appreciated so we knew exactly what we were getting. It delivered and we would recommend it.

name: Niki
review: We had a lovely stay. Room enough to enjoy our extended family of 8 celebrating our University of Bridgeport graduate!!! Perfect views and location. Would stay again.

name: Darlene
review: The house was very comfortable very nice to visit when I like most about it was my mom was able to get inside the house without any problem because she has issues with stairs. Thank you very much for allowing us to stay in your home. I really appreciate it.

name: Natalie
review: We booked a last minute vacation and this was exactly what we hoped for. The house is right on the beach. We loved being so close to the water and being able to walk on the beach and through the neighborhood.

name: Catarina
review: Very nice host that answers in short time. Very good and comfortable beds. Bathrooms very clean.

name: Dena
review: I absolutely loved this house! The location was perfect.. on the water with a long stretch of beach from the house to the ocean. Lots of space for games, a close drive to anything you need, lots of street parking, and the sunrises and sunsets were stunning! The house was well supplied with everything we needed, and the view from the master bedroom was fantastic! I would recommend it in a minute and would stay there again for sure!

name: Margaret
review:
My family visits Stratford every year to celebrate St. Patrick’s Day in honor of our mother.
We have a very large family and usually get hotel rooms.
I had 8 in my family so decided to find an Airbrb instead of a hotel room.
I found this sweet spot on the beach.
When we first entered I was surprised at how big the home was.
The bedrooms fit everyone’s needs.
Although the weather was cold, we spent a lot of time outside.
I would recommend renting this home not only in the summer but also in the spring and winter.
The beach was beautiful and we were the only ones there for miles away.
The home had every amenity needed.
Dimitry was very responsive and easy going.
He even allowed us to enter earlier since we were traveling from NH.
Thanks Dimitry for sharing your home.

name: Sandra
review:
My overall four stars is ONLY because a winter storm caused pipes to freeze.  The hosts alerted us on our way and worked diligently to correct the problem.  We were without running water for about 30 hours : (   BUT the hosts were doing all that they could to help.  Despite that, we thoroughly enjoyed our weekend and we were able to host our planned events with extended family.
We have stayed at this home before and REALLY like so many things about it. It is perfect for us when our whole family visits CT with us. It has great common area space, five good sized bedrooms, awesome outdoor patio and is right on the beach (not used during this winter weekend....).
The house is very well equipped and very comfortable.  There is ample parking on the street right outside of the house.  Location is very convenient for stores and restaurants.
Hosts are VERY helpful.
We will definitely be back.

name: Richard
review: Simple spot, right at the beach, convenient in and out for our wintertime visit during a family event nearby.

name: Thomas R
review: We loved it. It was on the water and very walkable even in the snow

name: Michael
review: We had a fantastic stay! Dmitry was incredibly proactive, which made us feel at home right away. While there we only had one question for Dmitry who was quick to answer us and even followed up with us to be certain we got what we needed. We had a wonderful time! Five stars!

name: Erin
review: The beach house in Milford was a great location. The host was nothing but helpful and always responded quickly to any questions I had. My friends and I had a wonderful stay. Would recommend in the summer and even later in the season. House was clean and spacious for all guests. I would return in a heart beat!

name: Sean
review: We stayed here for a wedding weekend. The place sleeps about 10 and easily hosts that size group in the common area. The surroundings are gorgeous, the area is quiet and safe and the house is adorable. We would stay here again in a heartbeat.

name: John
review:
Had a great time at Dmitry's place. Thank you for sharing your home. Just getting up early to watch the sunrise is worth the price of emission. The house was exact as advertised and well stocked with essentials. We had a wonderful time celebrating the arrival of our 1st grandchild.
Highly recommend.

name: Jennifer
review: Had a wonderful, peaceful stay and would recommend booking here. Minutes away from the Milford green, great restaurants and of course being right on the sand is the best.

name: Sarah
review: Dmitry's place was perfect for our family trip to the beach in the fall.  The proximity of things to do was perfect and the neighborhood was so peaceful.  The home is cozy and yet has plenty of space for larger families.  The piano and games were such a treat.  A wonderful family getaway all around.  We would definitely return!

name: Sandra
review: Wonderful stay. The house is great and perfect location.

name: Ruchika
review: Went to celebrate my husbands bday with family and baby in tow. It was a great great location! Right at the beach and it was practically empty so we felt like we had it all to ourselves. The house was conveniently located with all the ingredients packed in the kitchen and bathroom on ground floor. The construction next door, however, dampened our moods slightly with the loud noise during the 1 weekday we were there. Also was hard to get the baby to stay asleep with the banging. Otherwise highly recommended if you want to be right at the beach. Plenty of bedrooms.

name: Lisa
review: House location and outdoor shower were amazing.  Great place for young children and older adults.  Would stay here again.

name: Susan
review: PERFECT

name: Jeff
review: Great place, host and great location.

name: Brandon
review: Great place and great host!

name: Mark
review: Great host very clean beautiful views only concern was house being built next door as they start early.

name: Dominique
review: We loved our stay! The private beach was perfect for our kiddos - far enough away from the water that they could play independently in the sand while we sat on the beautiful deck. The kitchen had all the items we needed (we even took a virtual cooking class while there). Dmitry was super responsive and helpful. The master bedroom was a beautiful place to watch the sunrise/sunset.

name: Kim
review: Awesome place and great hosts!

name: Rayann
review:
We loved this Beach House!
The house was clean and the kitchen was full of cooking supplies. There was a variety of pots and pans to choose from.  This was appreciated since we are picky about the type of pans we cook our food in. The host provided a binder full of menus for local restaurants and recommendations. Information on activities to do while visiting was also included within the binder.
The house included a small fire pit that could be used at a distance from the house. It was just the right size to maintain safety and still be cozy from warmth.
Dmitry and his team communicated clearly and were kind by providing us with information about the local St.Patricks Day Parade. The neighborhood felt safe and friendly.  Perfect place to bring your family for a getaway trip. We couldn’t have chosen a better place to stay.
Special thanks to the host for helping me resolve a package delivery issue.

name: Kim
review: Beautiful house on the beach with plenty of room!

name: Sarah
review: We found Dmitry's place to be just as advertised - it was warm, comfortable and well stocked for our family get together.   We enjoyed the views of the water and the open common areas.  We especially appreciated having a full bath and bedroom on the first floor for our elderly mother.

name: Vincent
review: Great spot!  Dmitry was a pleasure to work with.  Highly recommend!

name: Michael
review: Dmitrys beach house was great.  My family and I rented the house for a new years celebration and it was the peaceful and relaxing getaway we were looking for this holiday.  Everything was clean and plenty of supplies to take care of everything.  So many pots pans and utensils to take care of cooking meals.  Right on the beach which is amazing.  The sunrises were stunning.  The only downside was the size of the common areas.  We maxed out the rooms with 10 guests so it was a little tight for dinner and was very easy to hear the other guests conversating downstairs as you were in the bedrooms upstairs.  A little tough to sleep unless everyone went to bed at the same time.

name: Wendy
review: We had a great stay - a family holiday, 7 people altogether.  It was lovely to view the beach and ocean from the living room windows, and the kitchen had everything we needed to serve a big holiday meal. The weather was freezing but we still enjoyed walking the beach. Thanks for having the heat on for us when we got there, Dimitry!

name: Tiffany
review: Great home and location! We will come back again when in town.

name: Doug
review: Great location on the water.  Well equipped kitchen.  Lots of towels and pillows.   Great deck.

name: Cecilia
review: Great place and location.  Excellent host.  We had problems with the cleanliness of the place. we suggest that they clean and tidy well before guests arrive.

name: Scesa Connie
review: This is a wonderful home to stay in. This home is relaxing and with beach access.

name: Florene Rose
review: Great host!

name: Mary
review: Great location right on the beach and park / boardwalk nearby so great for walking. The house had lots of sleeping options, something for everyone! Was wonderful to fall asleep listening to the gentle waves, took me right back to my childhood memories of our beach cottage. Would book again for sure.

name: Anne
review: Such fun – thank you for providing a wonderful accommodation!

name: Bart
review: Dmitry and team were responsive and excellent hosts.  Highly recommend them and their locations.

name: Milot
review: Beautiful home and location. House was great for our family and kids loved playing on the beach. Dmitry was super kind and welcoming. We will definitely consider coming back when the weather is warmer.

name: Christine
review: Great house right on the beach. We really enjoyed our stay. We hope to check it out again in the summer!

name: Sarah
review: Cozy space perfect for spending time with family with a beautiful view of the water

name: Carrie
review: Enjoyed our stay!  The charging stations for all types of electronics came in handy!

name: Clarissa
review: Lovey place to stay right on the beach. We were worried about finding street parking but that was not an issue! Hosts were responsive when needed. Walking distance to a few food spots.

name: Diogo
review: Nice and Cozy Place to stay. Dmitry was very friendly and easy to answer all my questions. Thank you and I Really recommend this Place.

name: Judy
review: Dmitry was very accommodating of a special request and it made all the difference for this trip. We used his home as a landing place for my work team to hold a small planning retreat. We were able to meet in the living room and spacious outdoor seating. The amenities were perfect and everything was in great condition. Really lovely ocean view! We would meet here again.

name: Marshall
review:
Awesome spot right on the water. Very cozy and relaxing.
Thank you so much

name: Casskell Stays
review: This house is a show-stopper. wish we could keep this one a secret. The backyard is absolutely beautiful could not ask for a better location. The house was cozy and bigger than you would expect!

name: David
review:
I want to thank the host for t hr beautiful min vacations we had. Gorgeous beachfront location, nice house. Very accomodative owners. We were traveling with older disabled parents and host went out of his way to make sure ee would have everything needed.
Definitely will return
Thank you again for the great week at the beach

name: Yolanda
review: We had a great time and hope we can go again in the future.  Marvelous place to have many wonderful moments and being in the hammock dreaming and in peace.

name: Danielle
review:
We had the most wonderful stay! Dmitry was super accommodating with an early check-in / late check-out and very helpful with local restaurant and grocery recommendations.
The house was perfect for us: the beds were comfortable, the kitchen was well equipped and there were many games and sports equipment for us to use on the beach and in the water.  The location could not have been better. I will definitely be returning and cannot recommend enough- only regret was that we didn't stay longer!

name: Logan
review: The location is wonderful! Right on the beach and felt very safe. Dmitry was very responsive and friendly.

name: Aesha
review:
Beautiful location, and close to good food and groceries.
The house itself is on the simple side. First floor shower was taped up and could not be used. And the house had a musty smell. We were also asked to take out the trash to the curb in the middle of our stay and receive Amazon packages and move them inside.

name: Evelyn
review: The location of the house is awesome. With the direct access to the beach, and a porch outside make the beach vacation very enjoyable. The only things not to my expectations were the house is smaller than it looks in the pictures, and the furnitures and kitchen appliances were dated. The cleaning wasn’t done very well either.

name: Margie
review: Loved the location and the house! Would stay again!

name: Rachel
review: We had such a wonderful time at this place. Outside seating was great and the beach is beautiful. The host responded quickly to any questions we had. The place was clean, spacious, and very peaceful. We would definitely recommend this place and stay here again!

name: Kailey
review: Dmitry’s home was a beautiful location for a girls weekend trip! The house was cozy and spacious and the views were incredible! Dmitry was very quick to respond to all my messages and was flexible in accommodating all of our needs.

name: Galen
review: Wonderful spot on the beach, very comfortable couches and beds, well appointed/stocked kitchen, beautiful deck, games/puzzles and a decent, small convenience store a short walk away.  We enjoyed an evening fire outside, and took advantage of the kayaks. Really enjoyed ourselves.  Dmitry was kind and responsive.  (We had a brief challenge with the Nest thermostat which he quickly and kindly resolved for us.)  Great experience overall - would definitely return!  Thanks Dmitry!

name: Jasper
review: We had a perfect stay in the cozy house. The view was wonderful. Communication went very smooth.

name: Mike
review:
Awesome place. Would highly recommend for beach season.
Definitely check this out if you want a beach place and good time with family.

name: Irwin
review: Perfectly placed. Safe, clean, and beautiful town to be in. Definitely recommend summer stays!

name: Adam
review: We spent the weekend here in November as a group of 8. It was a fantastic location. We never felt crowded. The house was very well equipped and clean. The price was fair for the quality of a house directly on the beach. Definitely recommend to others.

name: Liz
review: Lovely home. The view is spectacular and the location perfect. It’s right on the beach so you get to watch. The sunset from your bedroom window.

name: Minako
review:
Great Location with private beach.
Very Clean & comfortable!
Beautiful sunrise!

name: Jaclyn
review:
Dmitry is great. The location of the home was absolutely stunning. The views can’t be beat and the neighbors made us all feel like family.
However the home itself wasn’t kid friendly at all. I don’t think the host was ready for us as a lot of personal belongings were left behind. Having children we had to make shift a lot of the rooms so they wouldn’t ruin the hosts belongings. Clothes were in drawers and hung in the closets, other personal items in desks etc. Open kitchen panty stocked floor to ceiling with things kids should not get into. There was food in the freezer and no room for our stuff. It just wasn’t welcoming at all.
I read all of the amazing reviews and I assume given more notice he would have prepared better. But I wish we were given the option prior to arriving as we spent the first two days moving things around.
He was very good with communicating with us and trying to remedy the issues. And overall he seems like a fantastic host based on the reviews and what the neighborhood says about him.
We loved the area so much and can’t wait to return. But this specific home wasn’t suited for a family with children.

name: Susan
review: Dmitry’s home is in a great location with nice neighbors and a private beach.  We enjoyed swimming and kayaking and walking to Charles Island at low tide.  The house is well equipped with everything we needed!

name: Pam
review: This was our second stay here and we continue to love it!  Location can’t be beat, neighbors are welcoming, home is perfect!  We’re hoping to visit again next year!

name: Tina
review: What a location! Dmitry was fantastic in terms of communication and the home was really great.  The beach was incredibly private, there were 5 bedrooms (not 4!) and the backyard deck was really wonderful for family dinners and just enjoy the outdoors!  Highly also recommend walking to Charles Island at low tide (2.5miles, bird sanctuary) if you have the opportunity to do so.  Parking was never an issue and the beach (even on 90+ degree weather days) were empty minus our kids/family.  Beach was not rocky or with too many broken seashells to walk on which was an added bonus. Thank you again to Dmitry and family for sharing your home with us!

name: Yusuf
review: Dmitry was a great host!  Called to check on me and was very accommodating to our needs.  I was dealing with the death of my mom and this host made sure I could check in early and it was seamless.  The property is gorgeous.  I highly recommend this property!!

name: Eric
review:
Great house right on the beach with ample street parking.  4 bedrroms (3 upstairs, 1 off the kitchen) with one bath on each floor.   The house was as described and the pictures were accurate.     All the little things you need were in the house, like salt/pepper, paper towels, dish soap, towels etc...   Good wifi, streaming device on TV, board games, and playing cards around.  Also close to a nice park for a beachfront boardwalk run.
Dimitri was a fast & clear communicator.   Great stay all in.

name: Katherine
review: The location is perfect, right on the beach.  We didn't have any issues with finding parking right across the street from the house.

name: Joelle
review: Great location!  Beautiful view

name: Thomas
review: The house is wonderful, fully stocked and right on the beach.  Our family enjoyed the stay here very much and look forward to returning.

name: Amie
review: This place is in great location and the view is amazing

name: Chana
review: Had a wonderful weekend stay for a group of six. Plenty of room and absolutely magnificent ocean views.

name: Ila
review: Perfect getaway and has way more to offer that you just can’t put into words!!! What I can express in words is this house offers such a zen and fun atmosphere! The house has every amenity it says and extra! Options are there and up to you for what you want on your getaway. Kayak, fire pit, seating for meals close to the beach or closer to the house with a great view, walk on sandy beach in high tide or in the sound at low tide to an island, float in calm water, enjoy a beautiful sunrise or sunset, or just sit inside and watch the water and play games in a very clean and beautiful house! Only bad thing I have to say is I had to leave to return to reality and leave this lovely location!

name: Amanda
review: this place is amazing and has beautiful views! you couldn't pick a better place for a beach getaway. my favorite part was the herb garden right off the deck, which we ended up grilling our food with!

name: Jaimie
review: We really enjoyed our stay at Dmitry’s house! The house was cozy and clean and had everything we could possibly need. The location of this house is what drew us in and it did not disappoint. Having our own private beach was such a treat and waking up to amazing sunrises and that view is unforgettable. The beach is clean and quiet and the water was calm and perfect. At low tide we walked out to the nearby island and it was so much fun, and we also enjoyed using the kayaks. The area is great - Milford has a cute downtown with nice restaurants. Dmitry was a great host, very communicative and helpful. We hope to go back and stay again soon!

name: Nicholas
review: Perfect place for a weekend getaway. Right on the beach, we had fun relaxing on the sand and paddling in the kayaks. Street parking was no problem even on the holiday weekend. 5 star place thanks so much!!!

name: Jeff
review: We loved our week at Dmitry's house. It is on a lovely, quiet beach and it was perfect for us. The morning sunrises and evenings when we got the fire pit going were sublime. There were just three of us (parents and a 12 year-old), but the calm water and endless opportunity to explore and hunt for shells make it very well-suited for families. The kayaks, deck, beach chairs and grill are great for adults! Parking was super easy out front. As a side note - we were there when the remnants of Ida came through and the house took a pounding but came through fine. We hope to be back again with better weather.

name: Chime
review: Great location; enjoyable private beach + closewalk to Charles Island during low tide (highly recommended). Beach has gentle waves, soft sand and is not very deep (did not see a single jellyfish either).

name: Kelly
review: Awesome location and lovely, cozy home. It was everything we hoped for and hope to go back.

name: Elyse
review:
We had a great time at the beach house, and Dimitry was a great host. The house was equipped with everything you needed, and the beach was so nice we didn't even want to leave, which was made simple by many delievery options around!
I appreciate you letting us stay! What a fantastic, relaxing beach weekend.

name: Elizabeth
review: This place was perfect for a weekend getaway to the beach!

name: Jessica
review: We loved this house and it was perfect for our little getaway. Having the beach out the back door was a highlight. We had a wonderful time!

name: Jason
review: Wonderful home for a near-NYC getaway.  Idyllic beach, great patio/deck area to relax, and all the little touches in the house add up to a wonderful place.

name: Nivea
review: Dmitry's place is really nice, best view to the ocean ever. The place is cute and cozy. Private beach but no driveway, so don't park there even to unload as I did . My bad!! 100%recommended. I already gave to a friend the ad.

name: Julie
review: Amazing location, fantastic home, excellent host! Can’t wait to hopefully stay again!

name: Inkyeong
review: Great location and cute cozy house

name: Kelsey
review: Dmitry was a great host and was extremely quick to respond to questions I had. The house is great, and the location is great. I’m looking forwards to staying here again in the future.

name: Stephanie
review: The house was very lovely, and the location right on the beach was beautiful.  Perfect little beach getaway, would definitely recommend booking.

name: Jill
review: Beautiful beach house.  Roomy and welcoming.  Dmitry  is an excellent host.

name: Heather
review: Friendly host. Wonderful sunrises.

name: Zachrey
review: Dmitry's place was nice. Great location right on the beach. A little cozy and could use some finishing touches, but overall we had a great stay with 3 couples at the house.

name: Mike
review:
Good house, great neighborhood. Plenty of stuff to do, such as hiking, beach, places to eat, explore..etc. decent price
A few bad irritating stuff. No shades for windows so stranger can see through.  Certain sofas/furniture weren’t as clean. WiFi signal is choppy
Overall: my friends and I plan to do book this place again. 9/10

name: Chimene
review: We loved the location of Dmitry's place in Milford! Waterfront, with lots of outdoor amenities right off the back porch. Though it was just my husband and me, the house would be ideal for a family gathering or the like- there are lots of beds, and the space feels like you want to make a big communal meal. Would definitely come back.

name: Thomas
review: This is a great house for getting together with family inside and outside.  We found it very easy to do some elaborate meal preparation in the well equipped and stocked kitchen.  The house contains all the everyday items and tools we often miss on vacation.  The beach and the shore are wonderful: great views that change with the tides, sea creatures, wonderful bird life,  a tombolo to a close-by island.  I spent a wonderful 4 days there with my family including very young grandchildren.

name: Kelley
review: Had everything needed - outdoor space was amazing!

name: Mark
review: You will feel right at home.

name: Isa
review: Absolutely amazing location and house. Plenty of seating outdoors to enjoy long days and beautiful evenings on a truly gorgeous private beach.

name: Lola
review: This is such as nice clean beach house. Enjoyed visiting Milford and love the walks on the beautiful beaches.

name: Yoav
review: Amazing house right in front of the beach. It’s very relaxing, even in winter. The house has everything you need, even board games! Would definitely go back.

name: Bryan
review: Great place right on the ocean with comfy beds and all the amenities one could ask for

name: Paolo
review: Exactly what we wanted.  Would stay again.

name: Aidee
review: Photos are not recent

name: Julie
review: Great place, perfect location with Awesome views.  Loved how the kitchen was fully stocked with dishes/utensils, helpful for our large group.

name: Bob
review: A cozy spot,  a great view  and an hospitable host. Really could not have been better.

name: Catherine
review: Best place to be! Gorgeous views long walks down to the harbor and on the other end is the

name: Kate
review: You can’t get a better location than this house. It is right on the beach and has plenty of outdoor furniture for enjoying the view. Ample street parking and plenty of room for a group of adults. A lovely place!

name: Resa
review: This is a beautiful, clean, private seaside property in Milford. The owners are hospitable and respond very quickly to any inquiries. Highly recommended!

name: Cathy
review: Perfect quiet beach getaway! We loved our stay here. Would definitely come back. I would recommend it for anyone looking for a laid back spot to relax.

name: Jesse
review: We really enjoyed our stay at this property.  It’s a great house for family gatherings.  Can’t beat the location.  Right on the beach and a short walk to Silver Sands State Park.  The back deck has an amazing view and can accommodate a lot of people.  Wish we could have stayed longer.

name: Tai
review: Such a great location! It was so nice to be able to wake up and walk right onto the beach. The porch and common areas were comfy lounging spaces, there were plenty of pots and pans, etc. in the kitchen to cook our own meals, and there were air conditioners in each bedroom which made sleeping very comfortable. Thanks, Dmitry!

name: Margot Carlisle
review: This place has such a beautiful view. It was very clean and smelled great. The kayaks and paddle boarding was a great thing for guests to do. Overall excellent stay.

name: Larissa
review: We picked a random place halfway between NJ and MA, but had no idea how amazing Milford would be. We had a fantastic stay! This home is on an absolutely stunning private beach. A super relaxing and beautiful vacation destination.

name: Daniel
review: Great location, communication was good. Beach was very nice as well as the Neighbours’ who are very close on either side

name: Pam
review: This is a GORGEOUS location! There were 7 of us  spending a long weekend relaxing on the beach!  Location was perfect, home was awesome and the hosts were incredibly responsive and helpful before, during and after our stay!  We already began planning a return trip.  Thank you, Dmitry, Yuri and Kira for sharing your home with us!

name: Eileen
review: This house was absolutely perfect. We had a group of 8 and there was plenty of room. It was cozy, homey and gorgeous. Can’t wait to come back!

name: Therese
review: Wake to beautiful sunrises every morning. Dmitri responds quickly. Clean, comfortable, equiped with all the needed amenities for our family of five.

name: Peter
review: We pay a cleaning fee yet they want you to strip the beds and load diswasher.
